title: demote() does not reset _lowest_rank
description:
When a root is demoted to UNJOINED, _lowest_rank retains the old root rank (256). This constrains MaxRankIncrease checks in _admissible(), preventing the demoted node from rejoining if available parents would result in rank > 256 + 2048 = 2304. In deep networks where all reachable parents have high ranks, the demoted root cannot rejoin. Fix: add self._lowest_rank = INFINITE_RANK after line 158.

File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py
Line: 150
